title: Scalar systems with the prescribed ordinary cochain model
statement: For a prime ell, finite coefficient extensions E and L with embedding iota, and a scheme W, there exist coefficient scalar systems A whose ordinary sequence extension functor is exactly the functor of the prescribed integral comparison sequence scalar model. For every module N, sequence-site object U, scalar s and section x, the actual sequence tensor section is HEq to s times the ordinary scalar-adjunction unit applied to x. The notation is that of [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems], [stage3-pur-scalar-cochain-evaluation].

source.place: 03D7, ordinary scalar-extension adjunction; 03EK, tensor products. Fully proved ordinary substep of the strict scalar quotient comparison.

proof.text: Package the prescribed cochain model with its normalized ordinary scalar adjunction using scalarPackageExists. The generic sequence scalar ring map equals the actual comparison ring map componentwise; transport the model along that equality. The normalized unit formula identifies actual tensor sections with scalar multiples of the unit.

Choose the finite scalar packages from the proved scalar-data existence theorem. Apply the evaluation-transpose construction to these packages and the prescribed sequence package, obtaining coefficient scalar systems without changing its sequence model.

proof_origin.place: Ordinary balanced tensor and adjunction-unit naturality; fully proved private implementation helper, not a new sorry obligation.

lean.statement:
theorem fixedSystems_exists :
    ∃ A : CoefficientExtensionSystems l E L ι W,
      A.scalar.model.E = (integralComparisonSequenceScalarModel l E L ι W).E ∧
      ∀ (N : coefficientSequenceModules l E W) (U : (ℕ × W.ProEt)ᵒᵖ)
        (s : (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l L W).obj.obj U) (x : N.val.obj U),
        HEq (integralComparisonSequenceTensorSection l E L ι W N U s x)
          (s • (show (A.scalar.model.E.obj N).val.obj U from
            (A.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.unit.app N).val.app U x))
